subject: Request: Post-period continuity rider & evidence handover — Boreal Health
messages:
From: Elaine Zhou <elaine.zhou@borealhealth.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sam.park@borealhealth.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-period continuity rider request — SOC 2 gap coverage

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the SOC 2 Type II report you shared earlier this year. Boreal is moving through procurement and we need a short post-period continuity rider (a one-page statement or "rider") that confirms the controls that remained in place after the report end date (2025-12-31) up to the current date. Specifically, our audit team wants:

- A concise statement covering 2026-01-01 through today describing any material control changes,
- Confirmation of whether key control owners or KMS/HSM arrangements changed, and
- A list of evidence items we can expect (logs, rotation records, policy attestations) with approximate delivery dates.

We understand this is a common ask; if possible, could you provide an estimated timeline for the rider and an evidence handover? We can accept a brief signed PDF and a small evidence bundle via Drive.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Best,
Elaine
Elaine Zhou
Senior Security & Risk Analyst
Boreal Health

Attachments: Boreal_Sig_Request_Form.pdf (procurement checklist)

From: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: Elaine Zhou <elaine.zhou@borealhealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-period continuity rider request — SOC 2 gap coverage

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear ask and the checklist. We can provide a post-period continuity rider that addresses 2026-01-01 through today and a small evidence package. A few quick clarifications so we scope properly:

1) Coverage format — would Boreal prefer a signed one-page rider plus an indexed zip of artifacts, or a short PDF rider plus a shared Drive folder with manifests?
2) Evidence scope — do you need all of the token/key rotation logs, or just attestations and sample logs for the KMS/HSM items (we typically provide rotation records for the most recent cycle and attestations for ongoing controls)?
3) Delivery timing — our standard turnaround for this package is 5 business days once scope is confirmed; if you need faster, we can prioritize for a 48–72 hour turnaround with a small one-time administrative review fee.

Next steps from our side: I’m looping Laura (Compliance) and Naomi (Security Ops) to prepare the rider and compile an evidence index. Laura/Naomi — can you confirm availability to assemble the evidence and whether we need a signatures/DocuSign flow for the rider?

Elaine — if you can reply with preferred format and exact evidence items required, we’ll lock down the timeline. If helpful, we can also schedule a 20-minute call early next week.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security & Compliance (Sales Enablement)
Redwood Inference

From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Post-period continuity rider request — SOC 2 gap coverage

Thanks for the ping — Naomi and I reviewed Boreal's checklist. Proposed plan:

- Rider: one-page signed PDF stating there have been no material control changes affecting scope since 2025-12-31, with callouts for KMS continuity and personnel transitions. Draft ETA: 24 hours after scope confirmation.
- Evidence bundle: indexed Drive folder with the following artifacts:
  * access-control-attestations.pdf (latest attestation)
  * kms-rotation-samples.zip (redacted sample logs covering rotations in 2026-Q1 and 2026-Q3)
  * infra-change-log.csv (changes impacting production infra since 2026-01-01)
  * policydocs/redwood-change-control.pdf (current revision)
  * evidence-index.csv (manifest with delivery dates and redaction notes)
- Signature flow: will use DocuSign for the rider (we’ll send a link). No cost to Boreal unless they request an expedited legal review.

Naomi — can you confirm the samples above are available and whether we need to redact any user identifiers prior to sharing?

Laura Bennett
Director, Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
To: Elaine Zhou <elaine.zhou@borealhealth.com>, Samuel Park <sam.park@borealhealth.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 18:05:00 -0800
Subject: Delivery: Post-period continuity rider + evidence index (Boreal)

Hi Elaine / Samuel — attaching the rider and an evidence index for Boreal's procurement file. Summary:

- Attached: SOC2_TypeII_2025_Redwood.pdf (reference copy), post_period_rider_boreal_signed.pdf (rider), evidence-index.csv (manifest).
- Scope covered: 2026-01-01 through 2026-11-16. No material control changes impacting SOC 2 scope noted during that period. Personnel changes noted: one rotation in SRE (Jul 2026) with no control ownership change; KMS/HSM configuration unchanged.
- Evidence delivery: Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBorealEvidence) contains redacted sample logs and the documents listed in the manifest. DocuSign link for the rider: https://app.docusign.com/Sign?doc=RB-bridgerider-2026.

If you need additional artifacts (full rotation logs, expanded audit trail CSVs), reply with the specific items and we’ll propose a delivery ETA.

Thanks — Naomi Feldman
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: post_period_rider_boreal_signed.pdf, evidence-index.csv, SOC2_TypeII_2025_Redwood.pdf
